s: Dine tiltul hanner beshabbat ubo t' seipim: ner shehidliqu bo mibbeod yom vedalaq ad leachar shechasheka ap al pi shekkaba achar kak asur letaltelo kol hashshabbat kullah apillu letzorek gupo o letzorek meqomo veeno domeh lishar keli shemmelakto leissur shemmuttar letaltelo letzorek gupo o letzorek meqomo kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch lepi shebbeben hashshemashot keshehaya hanner doleq haya asur betiltul apillu letzorek gupo umeqomo mippene shehaya basis leshalhebet haddoleqet bo shehi muqtzeh venaasa hanner muqtzeh kamoha umittok shebbeben hashshemashot shehu techillat kenisat hashshabbat haya muqtzeh middaat haadam shehiqtzahu middato keshehidliq bo vaasao basis ledabar (haasur) hammuqtzeh huqtza lekol hashshabbat kullah kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"y. Vaapillu menora gedola sheddalaq aleha ner echad mibbeod yom naaset kullah basis lo veneesra betiltul lekol hashshabbat apillu leachar shekkaba hanner (apillu im enah shel peraqim) abal bashshabbat haacheret muttar letaltel hanner vehammenora letzorek gupan o meqoman kevan shello dalequ bahen bitchillat kenisat otah hashshabbat:

Veken hashshemen shennishar banner achar shekkaba mishshechasheka asur letaltel vekol shekken lehistappeq mimmennu kol otah hashshabbat hoil vehuqtza bitchillat kenisatah dehaynu shebbeben hashshemashot keshehaya doleq haya asur lehistappeq mimmennu mishshum issur kibbuy kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"h neesor lehistappeq mimmennu bekol otah hashshabbat vekevan sheasur lehistappeq velehanot mimmennu beshabbat asur gam ken letaltelo hoil veeno rauy liklum bo bayyom veod sheggam betiltul huqtza beben hashshemashot keshehaya doleq mippene shennaasa basis lashshalhebet shehu muqtzeh veken happetila naaset gam ken basis lashshalhebet veasur letaltel mah shennishtayyer mimmenna kol otah hashshabbat.

Ap al pi shehanner shehidliqu bo beoto shabbat asur letaltelo kol hashshabbat kullah apillu letzorek gupo umeqomo mikkol maqom mi shehu istenis vehanner hu maus alayv beshaa sheeno tzarik lo dehaynu (leachar shekkaba o) lemachar bayyom veeno yakol lisbol sheyyehe munnach etzlo yakol lehotzio mealayv lemaqom acher mippene shehare ner zeh lo kigrap shel rei lekol adam shehittiru letaltelo lehotzio mibbayit kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch (umikkol maqom en kol adam yakol lomar istenis ani ella mi sheyyadua shehu istenis):

Ap al pi shettiltul hanner eno asur ella mippene shennaasa basis ledabar haasur dehaynu hashshalhebet en hetter sheyyanniach al hanner mibbeod yom meat lechem o shear dabar hammuttar betiltul kede sheyyehe hanner beben hashshemashot basis leissur ulehetter lepi shehanner hu asuy bishbil hashshalhebet lekak hu tapel eleha velo lehallechem o shear dabar ap sheoto dabar chashub mehashshalhebet veken haddin bimnora:

Im hitna mibbeod yom al ner zeh sheyyetaltelennu beshshabbat liksheyyikbeh muttar letaltelo achar shekkaba veen omerim mittok shehuqtza beben hashshemashot huqtza lekol hashshabbat hoil veap beben hashshemashot lo huqtza middato lekol hashshabbat shehare haya dato alayv letaltelo liksheyyikbeh vahare bevadday yikbeh beshabbat kesheyyikleh hashshemen. Veyesh omerim sheen hattenay moil kelum shehoil vehiqtzahu middato leben hashshemashot dehaynu shekkeshehidliq bo haya bedato sheyyehe hashshemen doleq bo beben hashshemashot vihe hanner basis lekak huqtza lekol hashshabbat kullah veken nohagim bimdinot ellu. Venohagin letaltelo al yede nokri apillu lehatznio kede shello yigganeb sheasur kol zeman shehu doleq kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"v ap al pi ken achar shekkaba en bezeh issur shemmeachar shehamminhag kak hare zeh keillu hitna alayv mittechilla letaltelo al yede nokri liksheyyikbeh uleinyan tiltul al yede nokri somekin al sebara harishona shehattenay moil liksheyyikbeh vetob lehatnot kak beperush:

Vekol zeh bener shehudlaq mibbeod yom abal im hudlaq achar kenisat hashshabbat dehaynu mishshechasheka al yede nokri letzorek qetannim o letzorek choleh sheen bo sakkana o sheabar yisrael vehidliqo ben beshogeg ben bemezid muttar letaltelo achar shekkaba letzorek gupo o meqomo hoil velo haya muqtzeh bitchillat kenisat hashshabbat ella beemtza hashshabbat keshehaya doleq lo naasa al yede zeh muqtzeh lekol hashshabbat kullah ella beshaa shehu doleq bilbad. Vaapillu im hidliqo mibbeod yom im haya muttar letaltelo beben hashshemashot kegon ner shel chayya veshel choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana ap al pi shenneesar achar kak betiltul kegon sheyyolda hachayya veenah tzerika lanner venitrappe hacholeh mikkol maqom kesheyyikbeh hanner muttar letaltelo letzorek gupo o meqomo hoil velo haya asur betiltul beben hashshemashot:

Ner shello hidliqu bo beotah shabbat apillu hu shel cheres shehu maus keshehidliqu bo kebar vaapillu hidliqu bo nept shehu masriach muttar letaltelo beshshabbat letzorek gupo umeqomo sheeno muqtzeh mechamat mius hoil vehu rauy lekassot bo kelim veeno domeh litzrorot vaabanim sheap sheruyim lekassot bahem kelim asurim betiltul lepi sheen alehem torat keli kelal abal ner zeh yesh alayv torat keli:

Menora ben gedola ben qetanna im hi shel peraqim asur letaltelah apillu letzorek gupah umeqomah ap al pi shello hidliqu bah beoto shabbat shechosheshin shemma tippol miyyado vetitpareq veyachazir peraqeha veyitqaem vihaddeqem bechozeq veyitchayyeb mishshum boneh kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"g. Vaapillu im enam shel peraqim ella yesh bah charitzim sabib vedoma leshel peraqim asur letaltelah gezera shemma yomar haroeh shehi shel peraqim veyabo lehattir ap shel peraqim veap im hi qetanna meod sheen derek laasotah shel peraqim kelal vehakkol yodeim shehem charitzim bilbad velo peraqim ap al pi ken lo ratzu chakamim lechalleq bigzeratam ben gedola liqtanna:

Vekol zeh bimnora vekayyotze bah mehakkelim sheddarkan lehitpareq keshennopelim abal kelim sheen darkam lehitpareq keshennopelim kegon kosot vekayyotze bahem muttar letaltelam ap shehem beinyan sheasur lehachazir pirqehem kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"g vaapillu menora shel peraqim im peraqeha repuyim leolam sheen derek lehaddeqam bechozeq muttar letaltelah veap lehachazir peraqeha im napelu kemo sheyyitbaer sham ayyen sham hattaam:
